build_processor_from_pretrained: build a processor from a pretrained model using from_pretrained with cache_dir, token, and revision arguments
save_processor_to_disk: save a processor instance to disk using save_pretrained with push_to_hub flag for optional hub upload
load_processor_dict: load a processor configuration dictionary from a pretrained model path using get_processor_dict
apply_chat_template_to_conversation: apply a Jinja chat template to a conversation list and optionally tokenize with return_dict and return_tensors
instantiate_processor_from_dict: instantiate a processor from a configuration dictionary using from_args_and_dict with optional return_unused_kwargs
